base.description: The front-and-rear duct as Leviton ships 492RU-HFR, both covers fitted.

cover-off.description: The same duct with both snap-on covers taken off, the finger walls and their slots open to lay a cable in. The covers come with the duct, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

datasheet.title: Product Specifications 491RU-HFx, 492RU-HFx, 49265-xxx - Versi-Duct Horizontal Cable Management System

description: 2RU front-and-rear horizontal slotted duct, Leviton VERSI-DUCT 492RU-HFR: a PVC mounting plate on the rack rails with a 3 in by 3 in channel standing out of the front and a 2 in by 4 in channel out of the back, each with a wall of ten fingers along its top and another along its bottom, nine slots in each a cable is laid in through, and a snap-on cover across the finger tips that ships fitted and is pushed down and rotated off. A sloped section joins the plate to the rear channel and carries four oval pass-through holes in its top and four in its bottom.

gaps.note: the specification sheet, the product page and the instruction sheet state no weight.
gaps.wanted: a shipping weight on the product page or the specification sheet

gaps.note: the covers are snap-on and ship without a hinge; the Duct Cover Hinge (49265-HNG) is a separate accessory, at least two to a cover, and no view draws it. The format has no hinge, so a cover is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the hinge fitted

gaps.note: the specification sheet's page 2 draws a "Bend Radius Compliant Router (included with Horizontal Slotted Duct)", 3.74 in wide and 1.75 in and 1.45 in on its views, which snaps onto the fingers where cords enter and leave. The 492RU-HFR dimensional drawing does not include it, so it is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the router on the fingers

gaps.note: the covers are drawn from the outline of the side view and the top view's front and rear 22.8 mm; the thickness of their plates and lips is not dimensioned, and the lips' and the rear cover's are estimated.

gaps.note: the sloped section is a hollow of two sloped sheets and the ribs between its panels; the elevations draw it in four steps along the outline of the side view, and the ribs are not drawn.

body.description: the PVC mounting plate between the rack ears

cover.description: the snap-on covers across the finger tips of the front and rear channels, shipped fitted

fingers.description: the walls of fingers along the top and bottom of the front channel and of the rear channel

name: 492ru-hfr

attrs.note: datasheet - the material (PVC rated UL 94V-0), the standards (ANSI/TIA 568, cULus listed), the covers and the accessories are the specification sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - Leviton's application note "Maximum Cable Fill Ratios in Cable Managers" (NS-AN-23-006-05-30-23, 5/30/2023). Front: page 15, "2RU Horizontal Cable Manager 8.25 sq.in. (492RU-HFR, -HFO)" and, for the 6AS10 patch cord (0.240 in), 91 cords at 50 percent fill, 54 at 30 percent (the "recommended practical maximum" for patch cords in front managers), 45 at 25 percent. Rear: page 7, "Rear Channel of 2RU Front/Rear Horizontal Duct 492RU-HFR 1.625 in x 3.75 in 6.1 sq.in." and page 8, for a 0.240 in cable, 33 at 25 percent and 47 at 35 percent (the practical maximum for cable in rear managers). The cords and cables are named by Leviton part number or outer diameter and not by category, so no `cable-capacity-media` is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - 444.5 x 88.3 x 254.6. The plate is 19.0054 in [482.74mm] wide over its ears and 3.475 in [88.27mm] high; the body between its ears is the 444.5 from 19.15 to 463.65 on the top view (17.50 in on the specification sheet), which this library draws and not the ears. The 254.6 is the drawing's 10.025 in overall: 84.45 from the front to the ear plane, then the rear 170.2.

color.note: estimated - the specification sheet sells the ducts "with black covers" and names no colour for the duct; every drawing is line work, so the whole is this library's render of black PVC. The product page states no colour.

cover.note: datasheet - both covers ship fitted: the specification sheet lists the duct "with black covers" and calls them "snap-on duct cover"; the instruction sheet (Versi-Duct Slotted Duct System, horizontal slotted duct, step 2) says to fit the cover over the top of the duct fingers, push down and rotate it to the other side until it snaps into place. They are drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`. A hinge for each (49265-HNG, "Duct Cover Hinge", at least two to a cover) is a separate accessory.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the mounting plate: the top view of the 492RU-HFR dimensional drawing dimensions 3.3247 in [84.45mm] from the front of the cover to the back of the plate, and the front channel stands in front of it, the rear channel and the sloped section behind it, 170.2 mm of the 254.63. `at` is 84.45, so the part spans the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front channel with its cover fitted: 3.0 in [76.2mm] high over its walls and 3.38 in [85.9mm] over the cover and finger tips, its two walls 6.04 mm in from the top and bottom of the plate. The channel's clear size is 2.75 in x 3.00 in [69.85 x 76.2mm], 8.25 sq in, in Leviton's application note (page 15).

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the front channel stands 84.45 mm in front of the plane of the ears and the rear channel and its sloped section 170.2 behind it (the top view, 254.63 overall), so it serves the face it is bolted to and the space just behind the rails; at 170 mm it does not reach the rear rails of a rack, and the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - each duct is the channel between its two finger walls, run across the rack; finger pitch (49.375) and slot gap (22.45) are the top view figures above, and each size is the clear height Leviton's application note gives (69.85 mm in front, 41.3 behind).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the drawing's side view: the front channel and its cover, the plate, the sloped section narrowing from the plate's 88.3 to the rear channel's 50.8 (the drawing's outline runs from 0 to 88.3 at the plate to 21.1 to 67.1 at the narrow end) and the rear channel and its cover. The slope is drawn in four steps. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DIMENSIONAL DRAWING. Leviton publishes the 492RU-HFR drawing as DXF and DWG on its product page; the DXF is vector CAD in inches with five views (front, rear and side elevations, the top and bottom, and an isometric), with the dimensions 19.0054 in, 17.5 in, 3.475 in, 3.3247 in, 6.7003 in and 2.3865 in. The assembly in the drawing includes the covers ("w/ cover"). Every figure here is read from its line work at 25.4 mm to the inch: the side view's outline gives each channel's height (3.0 in over the front walls, 2.0 in over the rear's, the covers and finger tips 3.38 and 2.38 in, which the specification sheet's page 2 labels), the top view the slots, the plate and the ovals. THE SPECIFICATION SHEET'S PAGE 2 DRAWS THE DUCT'S TOP VIEW WITH FOUR DIMENSIONS (4.23, 2.50, 3.29 and 10.03 in) that this reads as the plan's rear section, sloped section and front section.

passes.note: drawing - the four oval holes in the top of the sloped section and the four in its bottom, as the drawing draws them in its top and bottom views: 75.88 x 38.1 mm, through the sloped section into the hollow between the plate and the rear channel. The first stands 18.96 mm from the left end of the duct and the rest 110.2 apart, the panels of the sloped section between 114.65 and 335.1. A cable laid over the duct can be put through one into the hollow and out of the opposite hole to the other side. Open: no document says the holes are closed.

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel with its cover fitted: 2.0 in [50.8mm] high over its walls, centred on the plate, and 2.38 in [60.6mm] over the cover and finger tips; the back of the plate and the sloped section round it. The channel's clear size is 1.625 in x 3.75 in [41.3 x 95.25mm], 6.1 sq in, in the application note (page 7).

thickness.note: drawing - the walls of the fingers are 2.54 mm [0.1 in] on the side view (6.03 to 8.57 and 79.69 to 82.23 for the front channel, 18.75 to 21.29 and 67.01 to 69.55 for the rear) and the plate 3.04, from its two faces 81.41 and 84.45 mm from the front.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the rear cover over the rear 22.8 mm, the rear finger wall and its nine slots from 23.1 mm in to the base of the channel, the sloped section with its four oval holes (75.88 x 38.1 mm, 110.2 apart, centred 116.2 mm from the front), the plate, then the front finger wall with the same nine slots and the front cover over the front 22.8 mm. The slots are 22.45 mm wide on a 49.375 pitch, the first from 32.65 to 55.10 on the drawing. The bottom is the same from underneath.

weight.note: no document states a weight: the specification sheet, the product page and the instruction sheet are silent. `weight-kg` is left out and a gap says so.
